source_basis: NCCP 00340 v4 and EMA Zykadia adult SmPC/leaflet retrieved 2026-10-29. Current 450 mg fed regimen; historical fasting-study frequencies are not transferred.

risks.label: Nausea, vomiting and diarrhoea
risks.detail: Daily prevention/rescue support may be needed; persistent symptoms, poor intake or reduced urine need prompt advice.

risks.label: Liver injury
risks.detail: Liver injury may be serious; blood tests are frequent early in treatment. Report jaundice or dark urine urgently.

risks.label: Lung inflammation
risks.detail: New cough or breathlessness needs urgent assessment. Treatment-related pneumonitis can be serious or fatal.

risks.label: Slow pulse and abnormal heart rhythm
risks.detail: Fainting, palpitations or severe dizziness needs urgent help; ECG/electrolyte and medicine review reduces avoidable risk.

risks.label: High blood glucose
risks.detail: May worsen diabetes or cause thirst, frequent urination and illness; fasting glucose monitoring and treatment may be needed.

risks.label: Pancreatic inflammation
risks.detail: Lipase/amylase can rise; severe persistent abdominal pain needs prompt assessment.

risks.label: Appetite, weight, fatigue and vision effects
risks.detail: Poor appetite, weight loss and fatigue can affect daily life. Report visual changes and avoid driving if affected.

risks.label: Kidney-test changes and dehydration
risks.detail: Kidney tests can change; vomiting or diarrhoea can cause dehydration. Report reduced urine or inability to drink.

risks.label: Pregnancy, breastfeeding and fertility
risks.detail: Discuss pregnancy, fertility and breastfeeding before treatment. Women who could become pregnant need highly effective contraception during treatment and for 3 months afterwards; hormonal contraception may be less effective, so agree a suitable method. Do not breastfeed during this treatment. Fertility effects are uncertain; ask about preservation if relevant.

risks.label: Food and medicine interactions
risks.detail: If illness prevents you eating with the dose, contact the team. Only the prescriber can arrange a different fasting dose. Do not alternate between fed and fasting schedules or change the dose yourself. Avoid grapefruit or grapefruit juice and St John’s wort. Check prescription, pharmacy and herbal medicines before use, including heart medicines, antibiotics, antifungals, seizure treatments and acid-reducing medicines. Do not stop a prescribed medicine without advice.
